summary: Build practical disaster risk assessment, mitigation, and response skills in 5 days. Enroll to improve readiness and reporting.
lede: Disaster risk management brings together hazard and vulnerability assessment, risk prioritization, and planning for mitigation, preparedness, response, and recovery. This course is for emergency management, risk, business continuity, and humanitarian professionals who need to turn operational observations into usable plans and reports. It develops practical skills in creating risk registers, prioritizing risks with a matrix, and designing preparedness actions, incident coordination workflows, and simulation exercises.
audienceIntro: This disaster risk management training is built for professionals who must assess risk, plan mitigation, coordinate response, and report readiness in real operational settings.
prerequisites: Participants should already have a basic understanding of emergency management, business continuity, or operational risk concepts. Experience in an operational, safety, resilience, or coordination role is helpful, and familiarity with hazard assessment or incident response processes will make the exercises easier to apply. No coding is required. The course introduces advanced concepts at operational application level, not technical engineering level, so you can focus on practical methods, planning tools, and reportable outputs.
